notes.title: While We Wait Here is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone ,
we're thrilled to share what we've been working on since Ravenous Devils. While We Wait Here is a story-driven thriller with multiple endings where you share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end. 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213120/While_We_Wait_Here/


In While We Wait Here, players take on the role of Cliff and Nora as they manage their desolate diner under surreal and puzzling circumstances. As guests enter, it is not only shakes and pancakes they’re after, but also shelter from what may be coming next. As conversations grow tense and the dread of the unknown begins to loom, what is happening outside quickly becomes the least of your worries.
Serve your clients, listen to their stories, and make the right choices. Will you let uncertainty and fear dictate your decisions? What will you make of the information the others begin to reveal?   

[previewyoutube=5Pi15kqruas;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Our next game demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
we are releasing the demo of "While We Wait Here", our next game. 

While We Wait Here is a [b]psychological, story driven horror game[/b] that blends the everyday with the surreal, presenting players with varying storylines, dialogue choices and multiple endings. Immerse yourself in the roles of Cliff and Nora, diner owners doing business on a desolate highway linking towns with the mountain range. 
Cater to customers, cooking up tasty classics and serve refreshing beverages, all the while the world grapples with what seems to be an impending catastrophe.


We can finally share with you what we've been working on for the last months and we are really excited to know what you think about it.

It’s just an ordinary day at Nora and Cliff’s diner; you’re in the middle of nowhere, flipping burgers, serving drinks, and enjoying good old fashioned conversation…
Then suddenly, a regular summer’s day is turned upside down with the arrival of a frighteningly giant storm. Some play it off, others believe it may actually be the beginning of the end. 
Nothing, in either case, is really what it seems.

[b]The demo is 15 to 20 minutes long with two endings.[/b] It's really important for us to listen to your feedbacks. You can leave them by going into "Your feedback" in the main menu of the game or you can post in in the Steam discussions or in our Discord server, the choice is up to you. 

We will read everyone comments ;) 

[b]Here's also a new trailer[/b]
Have fun!

[previewyoutube=WhQ0Y1MPNFA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Endless mode update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Ravenous Devils endless mode is now available with this new patch, we suggest you to try this mode once finished the main game.
[b]We also introduce Thai language with this update.[/b]

[b]The goal of the "Endless Mode" is to survive[/b] the policeman inspections and recurring taxes. If you get caught murdering someone or if you don't pay taxes when they occur you will be arrested. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/bea477c9c3b3029766614e7d6254b3543f126c94.gif[/img]

Here you can find out about the new content and challenges.

You can now customize the shops look buying the walls and floors in the "skins" tab, these are available also in the story mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/a49f7adb725483f292d1f976e07697f49ef245e9.gif[/img]

When you kill a client the "Wanted level" will increase

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/67277300f37402fb641daa437ca372a3920e0128.gif[/img]

The more the "Wanted level" increases the more will be the chances that a policeman will come inspect Percival's tailor room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/3495b7a17295630ffe46c5ab613d5b1914d4b765.gif[/img]

You can lower the "Wanted level" by not killing customers. Percival's customers in the tailor room will now generate an order. You can sell them a cloth to get some money and decrease the "Wanted level". If you don't sell them a cloth, when they leave, your "Wanted level" will decrease anyway, but you won't get any money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/c2b2f8190581077c67c3eaa2ec31741be1642de1.gif[/img]

If you don't have meat, because you are not killing customers, you can prepare new recipes that don't involve any kind of meat in the cooking process. Keep in mind that these new recipes are less worth than the meat-based recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/27b604197c2a92b9d8741a34113d2a5dab5f4b8f.png[/img]

There's a new machine that produces flour in the greenhouse, check it out, it's pretty funny :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40478836/b309fea1ed895688c2fd3dd8881441c3f761b970.gif[/img]

[b]Have fun with this new mode![/b]

notes.title: Ravenous Devils hits 100K copies sold and releases new in-game languages
notes.notes:
Hi Devils,

We hope that none of you have fallen into the meat grinder recently, because we have some awesome news! 

The game has officially reached 100,000 copies sold internationally (wow!) and with over 74,000 of those sold here on Steam, each and every one of you deserves our utmost gratitude. Because of all your fantastic support, we can now confirm five new languages have been added to Ravenous Devils. These are: 

Spanish
French
Korean
Japanese
Turkish

A full [b]German[/b] localisation is also on its way, and we’ll announce a date for it very shortly. The team also affirms its commitment to releasing an Endless Mode in the near future, a feature that has been much requested by players, and which will see Percival and Hildred set free to continue slaying and cooking their customers until there may be no one left in the city! 

You can expect an official date for Ravenous Devils’ Endless Mode sometime in the next month, but to make sure you don’t miss it, check out our linktree: https://linktr.ee/badvicesgames and follow us on your favorite socials. 

Here’s everything else we’ve fixed with this update: 
-Fixed a bug that was preventing tables from generating an order.
-Removed a red dot in the greenhouse.
-Fixed some texts.

That’s all for today,

Bad Vices Games

notes.title: A big thank you from the team!
notes.notes:
Devils!

These last two weeks have been absolutely incredible. 

We’ve seen thousands of you opening up your very own criminalistic restaurants all over the world, and serving your customers the most delicious of meals, cooked with murder and served with love. 

Your nice words and great feedback have been wonderful to read, and together we managed to see Ravenous Devils peak to #1 on Steam’s Popular New Releases on opening weekend, with 28,273 peak concurrent viewers on Twitch and hundreds of thousands of hours watched in the last two weeks. 

We’re proud of what we’ve been able to do as a studio and as a community, and now set our sights on improving Ravenous Devils further.  We have a host of new localisations coming to the game soon, and brand new game mode - which we’ll share more information on very shortly!
 
If you haven’t already, check out our linktree : https://linktr.ee/badvicesgames for links to our socials and to join our growing Discord community. 

To learn more about our publishers who have helped make Ravenous Devils possible, check out Troglobytes Games’ linktree here: https://linktr.ee/troglobytes

We really want to thank you for all the support you have already shown us, and wish you continued success in your killin’ and grillin’

Best, 

Bad Vices Games
